# Agent Gauntlet — Copilot instructions (public)
- Be concise and evidence-driven. Ground claims in repository files, tests, or linked documentation.
- Prioritize small, reviewable changes and clear tests.
- Do not include or suggest storing secrets in the repository.
- When in doubt, open an issue or PR; avoid making destructive changes without review.
